meta.name: Cadwell Park
meta.description: Cadwell Park, Full (3.50 km), Club (2.38 km) and Woodlands (1.37 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). Wooded parkland in the Lincolnshire Wolds.

imported.source: Layout and woodland (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, (c) Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2022, Open Government Licence v3.0. Widths: Contains Environment Agency information (c) Environment Agency and/or database right, Open Government Licence v3.0. Run-off, barriers and trees: measured from Environment Agency LIDAR point clouds (OGL v3.0) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL), barrier types from published track guides (tools/real_tracks_data/runoff_evidence.json).

kerbs.source: track guides: riders run along the left-hand kerb out of Coppice to set up Charlies (motorbikestoday.com Cadwell guide)
traxion.gg iRacing Cadwell guide: raised outside kerb on the exit of Charlies, a track-limits strike
motorbikestoday.com Cadwell guide: the kerb on the inside of Park Corner is fairly high
traxion.gg iRacing Cadwell guide: hug the right-hand kerb in, the left-hand kerb on power; one wheel over the exit kerb invalidates the lap
motorbikestoday.com Cadwell guide: riders go over the entry kerbs to straight-line Hall Bends
